description: Remove a password you know, or the printing and copying restrictions. Reads the local file, uploads it to the conv2pdf API, writes the unlocked PDF to output_path (or next to the input) and deletes the conversion job afterwards.

output_path.description: Local path the converted result is written to. When omitted, the output is written next to the input file. An existing file at this path is refused, never overwritten.

password.description: Password that opens the protected input PDF.

path.description: Local path of the input file. The file is read locally and uploaded to the conv2pdf API.

name: unlock_pdf
